description: This file defines models and a fetcher for Deribit options chains, including query parameter validation, data transformation, and websocket data extraction.

classes.name: DeribitOptionsChainsQueryParams
classes.description: Model for query parameters specific to Deribit options chains, including symbol validation.

classes.name: DeribitOptionsChainsData
classes.description: Data model for Deribit options chains, including various price and volatility metrics.

classes.name: DeribitOptionsChainsFetcher
classes.description: Asynchronous fetcher class for retrieving Deribit options chains data via websockets.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a DeribitOptionsChainsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously connects to Deribit's websocket API to fetch options chain data, processes websocket messages, and returns structured data.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw websocket data into a DeribitOptionsChainsData model, including unit conversions and sorting.
